title: AEGIS RULEBOOK_V3 v2.3.6.6
description: Only active rulebook. Visible indicators only; f1-f11. No CCI, WPR, or legacy v1/v2 rules.

definitions.CROSS_UP: value moves from below to above
definitions.CROSS_DOWN: value moves from above to below

rules.A_BUY: f7 < f11 AND f7/f8 Higher Low AND cross UP f11->f10->f9; then f7 cross DOWN f10/f11 while f8 > f10
rules.A_SELL: f7 > f9 AND f7/f8 Lower High AND cross DOWN f9->f10->f11; then f7 cross UP f10/f11 while f8 < f10
rules.B_BUY: f7 touches f10 OR f11 >=2 times AND f8 just touched/crossed f10 from above
rules.B_SELL: f7 touches f10 OR f9 >=2 times AND f8 just touched/crossed f10 from below
rules.C_BUY: f7 < f11 AND f7/f8 try cross f10 and FAIL; then f7 touches f11 >=2 times
rules.C_SELL: f7 > f9 AND f7/f8 try cross f10 and FAIL; then f7 touches f9 >=2 times
rules.F_BUY: f4 < f1 AND f4 < f2 AND f4 crosses UP f2 AND (f7 crosses DOWN f10 OR f7 < f11)
rules.F_SELL: f6 > f3 AND f6 > f2 AND f6 crosses DOWN f2 AND (f7 crosses UP f10 OR f7 > f9)
rules.EXPANSION_BUY: EXPANSION AND (f7 < f11 OR f8 < f11)
rules.EXPANSION_SELL: EXPANSION AND (f7 > f9 OR f8 > f9)
